description: End-to-end lifecycle for defining, launching, operating, and adjusting monetized APIs and plans in a TaaS Deep API monetization platform.

api_product_id.description: Unique identifier for an API product (a bundle of one or more APIs with a monetization configuration).

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for a monetization plan attached to an API product.

rate_card_id.description: Unique identifier for a rate card configuration used by one or more plans.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for a commercial contract between a provider and a consumer organization.

subscription_id.description: Unique identifier for a subscription of a developer/app to a monetized API plan.

usage_report_id.description: Unique identifier for an aggregated usage report snapshot.

invoice_id.description: Unique identifier for a generated invoice.

dispute_id.description: Unique identifier for a billing or usage dispute.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, JPY).

time_range.description: Time range used to filter usage or billing.

from.description: Inclusive start of the time range (ISO 8601).

to.description: Exclusive end of the time range (ISO 8601).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone name used for bucketing (e.g. 'UTC', 'America/New_York').

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the identity system.

impersonated_user_id.description: End user being impersonated, if relevant.

ip_address.description: IP address from which the action is made.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: define_api_product
functions.description: Create a new monetizable API product or update an existing draft, including endpoints, rate-limiting capabilities, and basic commercialization metadata.

api_product_id.description: Existing product ID to update; omit to create a new product.

description.description: Detailed product description including value proposition and intended use cases.

visibility.description: Who can see and subscribe to this product.

lifecycle_state.description: Initial lifecycle state; transitions are further controlled by other functions.

endpoints.description: List of API endpoints that belong to this product.

resources.description: Logical resource tags used for rate-card mapping.

burst_limit.description: Optional burst limit within the window.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata such as tags, internal references, or business unit.

functions.returns: API product definition including generated api_product_id and current lifecycle state.

functions.name: configure_rate_card
functions.description: Create or update a rate card with complex pricing rules, tiers, and regional overrides, to be attached to monetization plans.

rate_card_id.description: Existing rate card to update; omit to create a new one.

name.description: Internal name of the rate card.

billing_granularity.description: Granularity at which usage is billed.

rules.description: Pricing rules, typically scoped to resources or metrics.

region.description: Optional region or market code this rule applies to (e.g., 'EU', 'US').

tiers.description: Tiers for tiered or volume-based pricing.

fixed_fee.description: One-time fee applied when entering the tier.

overage_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to base unit price for overage charges.

custom_formula.description: Optional custom formula (DSL or expression) when pricing_model is 'custom_formula'.

region_overrides.description: Override settings per region, including currency conversions.

fx_rate_to_base.description: Conversion rate from base currency to region currency.

surcharge_percentage.description: Extra surcharge applied for the region, in percent.

functions.returns: Rate card configuration including generated rate_card_id, validation warnings, and effective pricing summary.

functions.name: create_monetization_plan
functions.description: Create or update a monetization plan for a given API product, attaching a rate card and subscription rules.

plan_id.description: Existing plan to update; omit to create new.

term_months.description: Length of minimum term in months.

discount_percentage.description: Discount applied in exchange for commitment.

auto_approval.description: Whether subscriptions are auto-approved or require manual review.

max_subscriptions_per_consumer.description: Hard limit of concurrent subscriptions per consumer org.

allowed_consumer_segments.description: Whitelisted consumer segments that can subscribe.

functions.returns: Monetization plan definition including plan_id, attachable product, and readiness status.

functions.name: publish_api_product
functions.description: Transition an API product and one or more monetization plans from draft/beta to active and discoverable states.

plans_to_publish.description: List of plan IDs to publish alongside the product.

beta_to_active.description: If true, enforce a beta-to-active transition otherwise allow direct draft-to-active.

effective_time.description: Optional future time at which publishing becomes effective.

deprecation_policy.description: Optional deprecation policy for older versions or plans.

functions.returns: Publishing result containing new lifecycle state, published plans, scheduled changes, and any validation errors.

functions.name: create_contract
functions.description: Create a commercial contract between provider and a consumer organization, used as a base for multiple subscriptions with negotiated terms.

contract_id.description: Existing contract to update; omit to create.

renewal_term_months.description: If auto_renew is true, term for each renewal.

pricing_overrides.description: Optional pricing overrides by plan or product.

discount_value.description: Percentage or fixed amount depending on discount_type.

functions.returns: Contract details including contract_id, negotiated terms, and status.

functions.name: subscribe_consumer
functions.description: Create a subscription of a consumer (or application) to a monetization plan, optionally under a contract.

api_keys.description: Optional pre-provisioned API keys to associate.

approval_note.description: Optional note added by approver when approval is manual.

functions.returns: Subscription details including subscription_id, status (pending/active), and effective start time.

functions.name: get_subscription_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status, quotas, and financial posture for a subscription.

include.description: Optional sections to include in response.

functions.returns: Subscription status including lifecycle state, effective plan, current period usage, quota remaining, and outstanding balance if requested.

functions.name: record_and_aggregate_usage
functions.description: Ingest raw API usage events for one or more subscriptions and aggregate them into a coherent usage report suitable for billing.

usage_report_id.description: Optional existing report to append to; otherwise a new report is created.

aggregation_granularity.description: Granularity at which to aggregate usage.

units.description: Number of billable units for this event.

preview_only.description: If true, compute aggregates but do not persist them.

functions.returns: Usage aggregation result including usage_report_id, per-subscription aggregates, and any rejected or duplicate events.

functions.name: generate_invoice
functions.description: Generate an invoice for one or more subscriptions/contracts over a specific billing period based on aggregated usage and fixed fees.

usage_report_id.description: Optional precomputed usage report. If not provided, the system will aggregate usage on the fly.

draft.description: If true, invoice is generated as a draft and not finalized.

min_line_item_amount.description: Line items with smaller amounts may be merged into an 'Other' category.

functions.returns: Invoice details including invoice_id, line items, taxes, total due, and status (draft/finalized).

functions.name: adjust_and_retry_billing
functions.description: Apply adjustments or credits to an existing invoice and optionally trigger a retry of failed payment collection.

adjustments.description: Monetary or usage-level adjustments to apply.

delta_units.description: Positive or negative units to correct.

retry_payment.description: If true, attempt to charge outstanding balance after applying adjustments.

functions.returns: Updated invoice summary including applied adjustments, remaining balance, and payment retry outcome when requested.

functions.name: file_usage_or_billing_dispute
functions.description: Allow a consumer to dispute specific usage or billing entries on an invoice or usage report and initiate a resolution workflow.

dispute_id.description: Existing dispute to update; omit to file a new one.

items.description: Individual line items or usage segments being disputed.

line_item_id.description: Invoice line item identifier, if applicable.

status_update.description: Optional status update for existing disputes.

functions.returns: Dispute record including dispute_id, current status, linked invoices/usage, and required next actions.

functions.name: list_and_filter_entities
functions.description: Generic listing and filtering for monetization entities such as API products, plans, subscriptions, invoices, and contracts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of requested entities with summary fields, along with total count and applied filters.

functions.name: suspend_or_cancel_subscription
functions.description: Suspend or cancel a subscription with appropriate handling for in-flight usage, invoicing, and potential rollbacks.

rollback_if_failure.description: If true, attempt to rollback subscription state changes if downstream operations fail.

functions.returns: Updated subscription state, any proration charges/refunds, and rollback status if attempted.

functions.name: api_monetization_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import api monetization entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: api_monetization_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many api monetization entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: api_monetization_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many api monetization entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: api_monetization_bulk_export
functions.description: Export api monetization entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: api_monetization_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across api monetization entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: api_monetization_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for api monetization events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: api_monetization_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for api monetization notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: api_monetization_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more api monetization entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: api_monetization_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to api monetization on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: api_monetization_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a api monetization operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: api_monetization_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending api monetization change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: api_monetization_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending api monetization approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: api_monetization_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a api monetization entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: api_monetization_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a api monetization entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: api_monetization_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a api monetization entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: api_monetization_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a api monetization entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: api_monetization_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for api monetization activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: api_monetization_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a api monetization view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: api_monetization_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to api monetization entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: api_monetization_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given api monetization payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: api_monetization_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a api monetization entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: api_monetization_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a api monetization entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
